  "summary": "This pull request adds support for persisting wallet seeds and introduces codex32 (BIP 93) encoding to enable paper-based backup and recovery. It ports the codex32 implementation from Core Lightning into C++ and adds two new RPCs: exposesecret to export seeds in codex32 format, and recoverwalletfromseed to restore a wallet from a codex32 string.",
  "problem": "Bitcoin Core descriptor wallets do not retain the original seed material after generating descriptors, preventing users from backing up or restoring wallets using physical, human-verifiable paper backups like codex32 without retaining raw database files or long descriptor strings.",

It ports the codex32 implementation from Core Lightning into C++ and adds two new RPCs: exposesecret to export seeds in codex32 format, and recoverwalletfromseed to restore a wallet from a codex32 string.
result.problem: Bitcoin Core descriptor wallets do not retain the original seed material after generating descriptors, preventing users from backing up or restoring wallets using physical, human-verifiable paper backups like codex32 without retaining raw database files or long descriptor strings.
evidence: The author states in the PR description: 'Because Bitcoin Core wallets currently do not store the seed material by default, this PR adds support for doing so, along with a new wallet flag to explicitly indicate when this feature is enabled.'

result.scope_notes: Includes a port of external code (codex32.{c,h} from Core Lightning) adapted into C++ (wallet/codex32.cpp and tests). It also introduces new persistent wallet database keys (WALLETSEEDKEY and WALLETSEEDCKEY) and a new wallet flag WALLET_FLAG_SEEDS_STORED.
result.card: This pull request adds the ability to back up and restore Bitcoin Core wallets using paper-based codex32 (BIP 93) seeds. Bitcoin Core descriptor wallets currently do not store seed material or provide paper backup workflows, forcing users to rely on electronic descriptor or file backups. The PR ports codex32 logic from Core Lightning, stores encrypted/plaintext seeds in the wallet database under a new wallet flag, and adds exposesecret and recoverwalletfromseed RPCs. The work is submitted as a proof of concept to gather feedback on seed storage in Core.
